raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "speak with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the agency from Reggio Emilia"
  role time "yesterday"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "say"
  role subject "the agency from Reggio Emilia"
  role object "for the rental contract the user must have pay stubs for the last three months"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "the agency from Reggio Emilia"

@s3 stated
  relation "work off the books"
  role subject "the user"
  role time "until last month"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "pay stubs to show"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to guarantee for"
    role subject ?someone
    role object "the user"
    polarity affirmed
  end
